C-SITE-BOUNDED-BRANCHES.Summary: Rebuild the AICC site as five bounded branches under one language-first layout, html/aicc/{en,ru}/ with a router index and the branches center, discovery, portfolio, program and lab, each built from its own Markdown source records instead of HTML sources, on one shared shell that works as plain HTML.
C-SITE-BOUNDED-BRANCHES.Problem: The Discovery catalog, the AI Lab and the project workbook are maintained as HTML under html-alt/, edited as markup and parsed back by builders; the parts of the site are not separable contexts, and the routes mix the AICC pages with the other sections at the language root.

Goals.Goal: Each branch owns its source root, schema, builder and checks: center (charter/, registry/, portal/content), discovery (portfolio/discovery/), portfolio (portfolio/), program (portfolio/ program records and projects/), lab (lab/).
All sources are Markdown records in English and Russian pairs with source pins, so the translation map, the review tooling and the source checks apply to every branch.

html/aicc/{en,ru}/index.html is a router to the five branches; every page carries the branch navigation, language counterpart and breadcrumb rendered at build time; search and the theme toggle are the only scripts needed, and every view is reachable without scripts.
A clean break: no legacy routes or redirect stubs; one 404 page; every internal link resolves; html-alt/ and finance-portal/ are retired once their content has moved.

Constraints.Constraint: Order: move the sources first with routes unchanged and output verified identical (Lab, then Projects, then Discovery); then switch to the new layout in one step.
No content is lost or changed by a source move; a move is accepted only when the rendered text of the affected pages is identical.
The branch named center holds today's AICC pages (charter, models, knowledge, templates, services).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Changing the content, the corpus rules or recorded states as part of a move.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Lab, project documents and Discovery are built from Markdown records; html-alt/ and finance-portal/ no longer exist.
The site has the router and the five branches in both languages with build-time navigation, a 404 page, and passing link, no-script and browser checks.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Rendered-text equality of each moved branch before and after its source move; no-script and browser checks of the new layout.

Assumptions.Assumption: The user approved the alignment on 2026-10-07 ("proceed"): language-first layout, router index, branch "center", clean break with no legacy routes, HTML first with search and theme as the only scripts, sources first then routes.
